bootstrap.wc_dependency: wcap_check_require_plugins() on admin_init self-deactivates if WooCommerce absent; Requires Plugins header also declares woocommerce
bootstrap.edd_sl_sdk: registered on edd_sl_sdk_registry (item_id 6, TODO placeholder); loaded from vendor/edd-sl-sdk/edd-sl-sdk.php if present
bootstrap.pro_coexistence: admin_menu for settings is NOT registered when woo-audio-preview-pro is active (free defers to Pro)

admin_surfaces.menu: WB Plugins (wbcomplugins) > Audio Preview for WooCommerce
admin_surfaces.note: Uses shared wbcom admin settings shell (admin/wbcom/wbcom-admin-settings.php). Settings tabs are informational/upsell; there are no functional storefront options in free.

admin_surfaces.fields: Exactly 3 fixed rows (name + URL). Row 1 primary, rows 2-3 optional. Media Library button (wp_enqueue_media) + Clear button. Live CDN detection indicator.

frontend_surfaces.placement: Single product page, just before the Add to Cart form
frontend_surfaces.player: Custom HTML5 <audio> player with play/pause, progress bar, elapsed time; preload=none. Google Drive + SoundCloud rendered via iframe embed instead.
frontend_surfaces.product_retrieval: wc_get_product(get_the_ID()) fallback for page builders / custom loops

ajax.note: nopriv variant is registered but handler enforces capability checks and bails for guests; deletes uploaded file under uploads/wcap_files and clears wcap_preview_attachment meta

post_meta.note: SAME meta key as Pro. Pro extends the array with wcap_audio_durations and wcap_audio_theme; free ignores those extra keys.

options.purpose: registered setting for Welcome tab (no functional payload)
registered setting for FAQ tab (no functional payload)
transient-style error queue displayed via admin_notices, autoload=false

assets.asset_resolver: get_asset_filename() picks min/RTL variant with fallback

primary_flows.owner_set_preview: Edit product -> Audio Preview Items metabox -> enter name + upload/paste URL (up to 3) -> Save -> URL validated (validate_audio_url) -> stored in wcap_audio meta
primary_flows.shopper_play: Visit single product -> player renders before Add to Cart -> click play -> HTML5 audio (or Google Drive / SoundCloud iframe) streams preview

free_vs_pro.free_owns: Up to 3 previews per product, single-product player before add-to-cart, CDN URL detection + playback, Media Library upload, shared wcap_audio meta contract
free_vs_pro.pro_adds: Unlimited previews, per-track duration limits, watermarking, player themes (classic/dark/minimal/colorful), archive/shop-loop badge, bulk import, drag-reorder, display-position control, multivendor (Dokan / WCFM / WC Vendors)
